Strategy: Keep the smallest size alive. Prefer a bin whose leftover equals the smallest residual open, so that size survives for future small items, while an exact fit wastes nothing and ties at the top. Score by distance from a leftover equal to the minimum residual, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin recreating the smallest size. It may help by keeping a small slot available, but may fail by chasing a size future items never need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = min(bins)
    return [-(abs(r - item - m)) + (m if r - item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Preserve min size: score by -abs(leftover - min residual), exact fits tied at top.
